_about: S5 fixture: a three-objective lesson of a made-up book (tests/fixtures/misconceptions/zz-test.json). lo:zz1s1-1-3 has no canonical solution, so S5 must skip it rather than write from general mathematics.

objectives.label: Multiply powers with the same base
Raise a power to a power

canonical_solution: The bases are the same, so add the exponents: $2^3 \times 2^4 = 2^{3+4}$.

canonical_solution.text_md: Same base, so add the exponents: $3^{2+4} = 3^6$.

canonical_solution: A power of a power multiplies the exponents: $(x^3)^2 = x^{3 \times 2} = x^6$.

sources.text: Do not multiply the exponents: $a^m \times a^n = a^{m+n}$, not $a^{mn}$.
The blind re-solve answered $x^5$ (added the exponents); the EPUB solution and the printed answer give $x^6$.
